title: PIAR computational laboratory: code and data for "From separatrix to strange attractor: Physics-informed normalizing flows for recovering missing dynamics in a spring-coupled inverted pendulum"
description: Python package, experiment and figure scripts, unit tests, interactive notebook, browser-based simulation, numerical results (JSON and CSV), and LaTeX source of the article and its supplementary material. Every figure and number of the article is regenerated from fixed random seeds. The spring-coupled inverted pendulum (PIAR) is used as a benchmark for the full-partial reconstruction mapping (FPRM) with a conditional neural spline flow, a conditional variational autoencoder, a denoising diffusion model, and Gaussian-process baselines.
